notes: Interprets the age predicate as applying to each outgoing target player; source players are unfiltered.
Uses the already selected temporary graph and externally bound INT64 parameter $min_age. Returns only the requested src and dst business-id columns.
The target-age predicate remains inside OPTIONAL MATCH so sources with no qualifying target produce dst=NULL. No DISTINCT or aggregation is used, preserving parallel-edge duplicate rows.

References: src/gql-query-generator/SKILL.md; references/query-language.md (MATCH and WHERE / Filter Placement); references/patterns.md (Node Pattern Filler, predicate scope, OPTIONAL MATCH); references/identifiers.md; references/checklist.md; references/validation.md (paths, optional scope, business identifiers, duplicates).
The bundled quote-identifiers helper confirmed s, d, player, follow, id, age, src and dst are ordinary identifiers. No database execution was performed.
